namespaces.name: n
namespaces.semantics: input is a normalised phasor; one cycle per unit

namespaces.name: r
namespaces.semantics: input is an angle in radians

namespaces.name: u
namespaces.semantics: output is mapped to the unipolar range

namespaces.name: b
namespaces.semantics: output is mapped to the bipolar range

namespaces.name: lfo
namespaces.semantics: free-running unipolar oscillator; rate is in hertz

namespaces.name: blfo
namespaces.semantics: free-running bipolar oscillator; rate is in hertz

namespaces.name: osc
namespaces.semantics: top-level audio-rate NodeDef from the synth registry

namespaces.name: k
namespaces.semantics: evaluate once when the program is compiled

namespaces.name: raw
namespaces.semantics: engine-native meaning, immune to bare-default changes

operators.description: Subtraction. With one arg, negates: `(- x)` = `(- 0 x)`. With multiple args, left-folds subtraction.
Multiplies all arguments together. Variadic: `(*)` returns 1, `(* x)` returns x.
Division. With one arg: `(/ x)` = `(/ 1 x)`. With multiple args, left-folds division.
Modulo (remainder after division). Variadic left-fold with 2+ args.
Returns the sum of all its arguments. Variadic: accepts any number of args. `(+)` returns 0, `(+ x)` returns x.
Returns 1.0 if the first value is less than the second, 0.0 otherwise.
examples: (< beat 0.5) ;; 1.0 in first half of beat

operators.description: Returns 1.0 if the first value is less than or equal to the second, 0.0 otherwise.
Returns 1.0 if two values are equal, 0.0 otherwise.
Returns 1.0 if the first value is greater than the second, 0.0 otherwise.
examples: (> beat 0.5) ;; 1.0 in second half of beat

operators.description: Returns 1.0 if the first value is greater than or equal to the second, 0.0 otherwise.

operators.name: a1
operators.description: Assign a signal expression to analog output 1 (through 8). The expression is compiled into a signal graph and evaluated every tick to produce a continuous voltage.

operators.name: abs
operators.description: Absolute value.

operators.name: ain1
operators.description: Analog/CV input 1. Returns a continuous value (typically 0 to 1).

operators.name: ain2
operators.description: Analog/CV input 2. Returns a continuous value (typically 0 to 1).

operators.name: and
operators.description: Logical AND. Returns 1.0 if both values are non-zero, 0.0 otherwise.

operators.name: b>u
operators.description: b>u operator.

operators.name: bar
operators.description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one bar (determined by BPM and time signature).

operators.name: bar-dur
operators.description: Duration of one bar in seconds (= beat-dur × beats-per-bar).

operators.name: bar-num
operators.description: Integer counter of total bars elapsed.

operators.name: bars-per-phrase
operators.description: Number of bars in one phrase.

operators.name: bcos
operators.description: Bipolar cosine shaper over a normalised phasor. Equivalent to b/cos.

operators.name: beat
operators.description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one beat (determined by BPM).

operators.name: beat-dur
operators.description: Duration of one beat in seconds (= 60 / bpm).

operators.name: beat-num
operators.description: Integer counter of total beats elapsed (floor of continuous beat count).

operators.name: beats-per-bar
operators.description: Number of beats in one bar (time signature numerator).

operators.name: bi-to-uni
operators.description: Converts a bipolar value [-1, 1] to unipolar [0, 1]. Formula: `x * 0.5 + 0.5`.

operators.name: blfo
operators.description: Free-running bipolar oscillator. Rate is in hertz; :wave selects the shape.

operators.name: bpm
operators.description: The current tempo in beats per minute. Readable in signal context; settable via `set-bpm` in cold context.

operators.name: bsin
operators.description: Bipolar sine shaper over a normalised phasor. Equivalent to b/sin.

operators.name: ceil
operators.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

operators.name: clamp
operators.description: Constrains a value between a minimum and maximum.

operators.name: cos
operators.description: Unipolar cosine shaper over a normalised phasor. Equivalent to n/cos.

operators.name: count
operators.description: Rising-edge counter: increments by 1 on each rising edge of the trigger. Optional `:reset` trigger resets to 0.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Signal to count rising edges of

parameters.name: :reset
parameters.description: Reset trigger (resets count to 0 on rising edge)

examples: (count in1 :reset (sqr bar)) ;; count inputs, reset each bar

operators.name: d1
operators.description: Assign a signal expression to digital output 1 (through 8). The expression is evaluated every tick; non-zero = high, zero = low.

operators.name: def
operators.description: def operator.

operators.name: define
operators.description: Creates a named cell (reactive binding). The expression is stored and recompiled into any output that references it. Redefining a cell invalidates all dependent outputs.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: The expression to bind (can be time-varying)

examples:
(define my-lfo (sin bar))
(a1 my-lfo) ;; uses the defined signal

operators.name: defn
operators.description: Defines a named function. In signal context, functions are inlined at every call site (no closures). Parameters are bound to argument expressions at compile time.

operators.name: defs
operators.description: Bulk define: defines multiple name/value pairs in one form. Equivalent to multiple `define` calls.

parameters.name: pairs
parameters.description: Alternating name/value pairs in a vector

operators.name: defstate
operators.description: Defines a stateful accumulator cell. Stores persistent state that updates each tick. Initial value must be a literal number.

parameters.name: init
parameters.description: Initial value (must be a literal number)

parameters.name: update-expr
parameters.description: Expression computed each tick (can reference the state variable by name)

operators.name: defun
operators.description: defun operator.

operators.name: dm
operators.description: Demux/conditional gate: if condition is non-zero, output value; otherwise output default. `(dm condition default value)`.
examples: (dm in1 0 (sin beat)) ;; sine when input high, 0 when low

operators.name: do
operators.description: Evaluates expressions in sequence, returns the last value. Useful for grouping multiple output assignments or side-effects at top level.

operators.name: dt
operators.description: Time delta between the current sample and the previous sample, in seconds. Useful for rate-based calculations.

operators.name: env-follow
operators.description: Asymmetric envelope follower. Rises quickly (attack) and falls slowly (release). Defaults: attack=10, release=5.

operators.name: envelope-follower
operators.description: envelope-follower operator.

operators.name: eu
operators.description: Short spelling of euclid, with the same hits-first, phasor-last signature.

operators.name: euclid
operators.description: Euclidean rhythm generator with hits first and the driving phasor last.

parameters.name: hits
parameters.description: Active hits distributed through the pattern

parameters.name: phasor
parameters.description: Driving phasor; always the final argument

operators.name: eval-at-time
operators.description: Evaluate body at an arbitrary time value. Replaces the time context entirely — the body sees the given time expression as `t`.

parameters.name: time-expr
parameters.description: The time value to evaluate at

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate at that time

examples: (eval-at-time (* 2 t) beat) ;; beat at double real-time

operators.name: expt
operators.description: Raises base to a power. Standard argument order: `(expt base exponent)` = base^exponent.

operators.name: fast
operators.description: Speed up time for everything inside the body. All time-leaves (beat, bar, t, etc.) inside the body run faster by the given factor.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Expression whose time is sped up

operators.name: flatseq
operators.description: flatseq operator.

operators.name: floor
operators.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

operators.name: fn
operators.description: fn operator.

operators.name: for
operators.description: Compile-time loop: unrolls over a collection at compile time. The collection must be a constant (literal vector or `range`). Returns the last iteration's value.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Compile-time constant collection to iterate over

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Expression to evaluate for each element

operators.name: frac
operators.description: Fractional part of a number: `x - floor(x)`. Always in [0, 1).

operators.name: from-list
operators.description: from-list operator.

operators.name: gates
operators.description: Gate sequencer: outputs 1 during the first `width` fraction of each step where the pattern value is non-zero, 0 otherwise. Width defaults to 0.5 (50% duty cycle). Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of gate values (0 = off, non-zero = on)

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Gate duty cycle (fraction of step duration)

operators.name: gatesw
operators.description: Gate sequencer with per-step pulse width control. Values 0-9 encode both gate-on and pulse width: 0 = off, 1 = shortest gate, 9 = full-length tie. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of gate+width values (0 = off, 1-9 = increasing pulse width)

operators.name: get-clock-source
operators.description: get-clock-source operator.

operators.name: get-expr
operators.description: Retrieves the stored source expression for a named cell. Useful for inspection/debugging.

operators.name: if
operators.description: Conditional: returns `then` value when condition is non-zero, `else` value otherwise. Else defaults to 0.0 if omitted.
examples: (a1 (if in1 (sin bar) 0)) ;; sine when input high

operators.name: in1
operators.description: Digital input 1. Returns 0 or 1.

operators.name: in2
operators.description: Digital input 2. Returns 0 or 1.

operators.name: index-rand
operators.description: Deterministic random value keyed by an arbitrary index. Same index always produces the same value. Useful for creating repeatable pseudo-random patterns.

operators.name: input
operators.description: Read a hardware input by channel number. Channel must be a constant: 0=in1, 1=in2, 2=ain1, 3=ain2.

operators.name: integrate
operators.description: Stateful accumulator: adds `rate × dt` each tick. Wraps around — use `clamp` or `%` to bound. Keyword `:id` for explicit state identity.

operators.name: interp
operators.description: Linear interpolation through a list of values, treating them as a continuous envelope. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of values to interpolate between

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: Position in envelope (0 = first value, 1 = last value)

operators.name: lambda
operators.description: Creates an anonymous function. Must be defined with `defn` and called by name in signal context — inline anonymous lambdas in signal expressions will produce an error suggesting this.
examples:
;; In cold context, lambdas work directly:
(define scale-fn (fn [x] (* x 0.5)))

operators.name: latch
operators.description: latch operator.

operators.name: lerp
operators.description: Linear interpolation between two values. `(lerp a b t)` = a + (b - a) * t.

operators.name: let
operators.description: Local bindings. Creates named values scoped to the body. Bindings are pairs in a vector: `[name1 val1 name2 val2 ...]`.

operators.name: lfo
operators.description: Free-running unipolar oscillator. Rate is in hertz; :wave selects the shape.

operators.name: live-edit
operators.description: Runtime-adjustable parameter. Creates a value that can be modified from the editor UI without re-evaluating. Keyword options control range, name, and step size.

operators.name: loop-at
operators.description: Loops time modulo a duration. The body's time resets every `duration` seconds.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Loop length in the time domain

operators.name: max
operators.description: Returns the maximum of its arguments. Variadic left-fold with 2+ args.

operators.name: min
operators.description: Returns the minimum of its arguments. Variadic left-fold with 2+ args.

operators.name: mod
operators.description: mod operator.

operators.name: neg
operators.description: Negate a value (multiply by -1).

operators.name: noise
operators.description: Deterministic white noise [-1, 1]. Changes every sample. Uses a hash counter for reproducibility.

operators.name: not
operators.description: Logical NOT. Returns 1.0 if the value is 0 (falsy), 0.0 otherwise.

operators.name: offset
operators.description: Shift time forward for everything inside the body. Offsets all time-leaves by the given amount. Commonly used to offset phasors: `(offset 0.5 bar)` starts the bar phasor from the halfway point.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Time offset amount (for phasors: 0-1 shifts start point)

operators.name: one-pole
operators.description: First-order low-pass filter (one-pole). Smooths the input signal with a given cutoff coefficient.

operators.name: or
operators.description: Logical OR. Returns 1.0 if either value is non-zero, 0.0 otherwise.

operators.name: osc/sine
operators.description: Audio-rate osc/sine synth node from the runtime registry.

operators.name: phasor
operators.description: Free-running phasor at a given frequency (Hz). Ramps from 0 to 1 continuously. Independent of beat/bar timing. Keyword `:phase` sets initial phase, `:id` for state identity.

operators.name: phrase
operators.description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one phrase (multiple bars).

operators.name: phrases-per-section
operators.description: Number of phrases in one section.

operators.name: pow
operators.description: Raises base to a power. Note argument order: `(pow exponent base)` = base^exponent.

operators.name: premap
operators.description: premap operator.

operators.name: prev
operators.description: Reads the previous tick's output value for a named output. Enables feedback between outputs.

parameters.name: output-name
parameters.description: Name of an output (a1-a8, d1-d8, s1-s8)

operators.name: pulse
operators.description: Width-configured unipolar pulse shaper. The driving phasor is last.

operators.name: q/crossings
operators.description: q/crossings operator.

operators.name: q/explain
operators.description: q/explain operator.

operators.name: q/range
operators.description: q/range operator.

operators.name: q/zeros
operators.description: q/zeros operator.

operators.name: random
operators.description: Deterministic per-beat random value. Changes once per beat (affected by fast/slow). Returns a float in [0,1] with no args, or scaled to [lo, hi] with args.

operators.name: range
operators.description: Creates a compile-time sequence of numbers. All arguments must be constants. `(range end)`, `(range start end)`, or `(range start end step)`.

operators.name: rate-as
operators.description: rate-as operator.

operators.name: reset-clock-ext
operators.description: reset-clock-ext operator.

operators.name: reset-clock-int
operators.description: reset-clock-int operator.

operators.name: ridx
operators.description: Ratio-indexed steps. Divides a phasor by ratios and outputs the normalised index (i/N) of the current subdivision. Useful as a phasor for indexing other sequences with non-uniform timing. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

operators.name: rpulse
operators.description: Generates pulses at ratio-divided phasor sections. The ratios list defines relative timing divisions; a pulse fires at the start of each section. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.
examples: (d1 (rpulse [1 1] 0.5 bar)) ;; two equal pulses per bar

operators.name: rstep
operators.description: Sample-and-hold on phasor at ratio-timed points. Returns the normalised start position of the current subdivision. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

operators.name: rwarp
operators.description: Remaps time through non-uniform subdivisions. Like `ridx` but produces ramps between points (continuous) rather than steps. Useful for driving `gatesw` with non-uniform timing. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

operators.name: s1
operators.description: Assign a signal expression to serial output 1 (through 8). Values are streamed over USB serial as binary messages. Can be decoded by the editor for MIDI output etc.

operators.name: sah
operators.description: Sample and hold: captures the input value on each rising edge of the trigger signal. Holds the value until the next trigger.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Trigger signal (samples on rising edge: 0→non-zero transition)

examples: (a1 (sah ain1 (sqr beat))) ;; sample CV each beat

operators.name: saw
operators.description: Pure unipolar saw shaper over a normalised phasor; allocates no state.

operators.name: scale
operators.description: Scales a value from [0, 1] to a target range. `(scale out-min out-max value)` maps value from [0,1] to [out-min, out-max].

operators.name: scope
operators.description: scope operator.

operators.name: section
operators.description: A phasor rising from 0 to 1 over the duration of one section (multiple phrases).

operators.name: seq
operators.description: seq operator.

operators.name: set
operators.description: Evaluates the expression immediately and stores the resulting numeric value. Unlike `define`, the stored value is static — it won't update reactively if dependencies change.
examples: (set snapshot bar) ;; captures bar's value at this instant

operators.name: set-bpm
operators.description: Set the sequencer tempo in beats per minute.

operators.name: set-clock-ext
operators.description: set-clock-ext operator.

operators.name: set-clock-int
operators.description: set-clock-int operator.

operators.name: set-time-sig
operators.description: Set the time signature (beats per bar and subdivision).

operators.name: shift
operators.description: shift operator.

operators.name: sin
operators.description: Unipolar sine shaper over a normalised phasor. Equivalent to n/sin.

operators.name: slew
operators.description: Slew rate limiter: smoothly transitions towards target at a maximum rate (units per second). Useful for portamento, smoothing, lag.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Maximum rate of change (units per second)

operators.name: slow
operators.description: Slow down time for everything inside the body. All time-leaves inside the body run slower by the given factor.

operators.name: sqr
operators.description: Square wave shaper. Converts a phasor to a square wave (0 or 1). With 1 arg: 50% duty cycle. With 2 args: `(sqr duty phase)`.

parameters.name: duty
parameters.description: Pulse width (fraction of cycle that is high)

examples: (d1 (sqr beat)) ;; gate: high for first half of each beat

operators.name: sqrt
operators.description: Square root.

operators.name: step
operators.description: Step sequencer: indexes a data list by a phasor. Divides the phasor range into equal steps and outputs the value at the current step. Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List/vector of values to sequence through

operators.name: synth
operators.description: synth operator.

operators.name: t
operators.description: Logical transport time in seconds since last reset. Monotonically increasing during playback. Resets with transport controls.

operators.name: tan
operators.description: Tangent function. Takes radians.

operators.name: time-as
operators.description: time-as operator.

operators.name: toggle
operators.description: T-flip-flop: toggles between 0 and 1 on each rising edge of the trigger.
examples: (d1 (toggle in1)) ;; toggle output on button press

operators.name: tri
operators.description: Triangle wave shaper. With 1 arg: symmetric triangle from phasor. With 2 args: `(tri duty phase)` — duty controls the peak position (0-1).

parameters.name: duty
parameters.description: Peak position within cycle (0 = immediate fall, 0.5 = symmetric, 1 = immediate rise)

operators.name: trigs
operators.description: Trigger sequencer: like `gates` but outputs gate values directly (0-1 amplitude). Phase defaults to `beat` if omitted.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: List of trigger values (0 = off, 1-9 = amplitude levels)

operators.name: u>b
operators.description: u>b operator.

operators.name: unassign
operators.description: unassign operator.

operators.name: uni-to-bi
operators.description: Converts a unipolar value [0, 1] to bipolar [-1, 1]. Formula: `x * 2 - 1`.

operators.name: useq-clear
operators.description: Clears all outputs and resets the signal engine. All running programs stop immediately.

operators.name: useq-nudge-time
operators.description: Nudge the time offset by a delta (positive = forward, negative = backward).

operators.name: useq-pause
operators.description: Pause playback. Time stops advancing but outputs hold their current values.

operators.name: useq-play
operators.description: Start/resume playback. Time begins advancing.

operators.name: useq-rewind
operators.description: Reset time offset to zero without stopping playback.

operators.name: useq-set-time-offset
operators.description: Set the absolute time offset in seconds.

operators.name: useq-stop
operators.description: Stop playback and reset time to zero.

operators.name: while
operators.description: Signal gate: returns body value when condition is non-zero, 0.0 when condition is zero. In signal context this is NOT a loop — it's a conditional gate.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Value to pass through when gate is open

examples: (while in1 (sin beat)) ;; sine only when input high

operators.name: with-state-id
operators.description: with-state-id operator.

operators.name: zeros
operators.description: Creates a vector of zeros of the specified length. Useful for initializing sequence data.
